'''Nenci''' is a ''[[damane]]'' in the [[Seanchan]] army.

== Activities ==
She is present at the meeting between the [[Dragon Reborn]] and the [[Daughter of the Nine Moons]], when it was revealed that the later was actually [[Semirhage]] in disguise.
